fusions.name: Spore Spray
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of spores that deals 4 damage to everything caught in it, with a 30% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Pounce and Pin
fusions.desc: Rushes 6 tiles to the target and deals 14 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Resting Ground
fusions.desc: Raises a patch of growth where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Rooted Loyalty
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 10%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.
